subject: Re: SDLC evidence delivery and redaction — BrightBank intake
messages:
From: BrightBank Audit Team <soc2@brightbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SDLC evidence — code review, CI traces, secret handling

Hi Hannah / Jordan,

Thanks for taking this. As part of BrightBank's SIG/SOC2 intake we need a focused evidentiary bundle for Secure SDLC covering code review, CI/CD controls, secrets management, and change approvals. Can you provide the following artifacts or confirm where we can pull them (redaction guidance below):

- PR sample (20 PRs across main services, include merge approvals and reviewer IDs)
- CI run logs for the PRs listed (attest which fields must be redacted)
- Policy or process doc for ephemeral credentials/short-lived tokens and rotation cadence
- Change management approval matrix and the last 6 approved change tickets that required canary or rollback plans
- A manifest mapping the artifacts to SIG/SOC2 control IDs

Please attach any redaction rules or scripts you recommend; BrightBank needs to avoid customer PII and internal token values. I attached our intake form (SIG_Request_Form.pdf) — feel free to call out anything that will take longer than 5 business days.

Regards,
BrightBank Audit Team
soc2@brightbank.com

--- attachment: SIG_Request_Form.pdf (application/pdf, 180KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: BrightBank Audit Team <soc2@brightbank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence — code review, CI traces, secret handling

Hi — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a scoped package and a manifest; timeline below. Quick notes up front:

- We'll provide a CSV manifest that maps evidence to SIG control ids and the specific PR/CI runs.
- For CI logs we will redact token values and IPs by default; we'll include a redaction script and a short guidance sheet.
- Change tickets will be exported with metadata (ticket id, owner, approver list, canary flag); we will redact internal-only routing notes per your PII guidance.

Proposed delivery plan:
1) T+2 business days: manifest + PR list (CSV) for your review; sample of 3 fully redacted CI logs.
2) T+5 business days: full PR sample (20 PRs) + CI logs + change ticket exports + redaction script.

I'll attach the initial manifest (sdlc_evidence_manifest_v1.csv) so you can confirm the mapping format. If that looks good we'll start the export.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Security Program Manager — Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0123 | hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

--- attachment: sdlc_evidence_manifest_v1.csv (text/csv, 6KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: BrightBank Audit Team <soc2@brightbank.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence — code review, CI traces, secret handling

Hi — tagging onto Hannah's plan with concrete locations and redaction approach so you know what to expect.

Where artifacts will come from:
- PRs: GitHub org "redwood-inference" -> repo set labeled "prod-*". We'll provide the PR numbers and an export of the review thread (reviewer + timestamp + comments).
- CI logs: stored in our internal ELK bucket; per-PR runs named by pipeline id.
- Change tickets: Jira project REDW-CHG, filter: labels:soc2_evidence AND status:Closed, last 6 entries.

Redaction and automation:
- We will run a scripted redaction that masks bearer tokens, long hex keys, and any alphanumeric strings matching our KMS token pattern.
- Script will also remove stack traces that contain internal hostnames; we will retain the CI step name, status, timing, and artifact references.
- Attached is a stub of the redaction script and the exported PR list.

Deliverables (technical):
- pr-sample-list.txt (20 PR numbers + repo)
- ci-log-redaction-script.sh (stub; we will run internally and provide redacted outputs)
- jira-export-change-tickets.jsonl (redacted fields) — note: we will deliver as newline-delimited JSON but redact freeform comments per policy.

If BrightBank needs the raw (unredacted) artifacts for a secure on-site review, we'll coordinate an account-specific encrypted transfer and a supervised access window.

Jordan Blake
Director, Platform Security — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0189

--- attachment: pr-sample-list.txt (text/plain, 2KB)
--- attachment: ci-log-redaction-script.sh (text/x-sh, 3KB stub)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence — code review, CI traces, secret handling

Added: I'll own the Jira export and will redact freeform comments that may contain internal IDs. Confirming T+5 delivery for the full bundle — escalation path if any ticket requires legal or product sign-off.

Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Programs — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: L. Cho <lisa.cho@assessorco.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBank Audit Team <soc2@brightbank.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence — code review, CI traces, secret handling

Hannah / Jordan / Kimberly — thanks for the quick plan. A couple clarifications before you start full exports: 

1) Redaction scope: please keep the following visible in redacted CI logs: step name, step status, duration, artifact SHA, and reviewer emails (redacted to user@redwood.com format). Mask bearer tokens and any long hex keys.
2) For PR reviewer IDs: we need reviewer email prefix (e.g., j.blake@redwood.com -> j.blake@redwood.com) but not internal employee numbers.
3) Can you confirm whether the change ticket exports will include rollback playbooks as attachments (we may request those separately if they contain confidential runbooks).

If the manifest + 3 sample logs look good we'll accept the full bundle by Tue, 19 Aug 2025 EOD. If you need an earlier supervised transfer window for unredacted artifacts we can coordinate.

Regards,
Lisa Cho
Senior Assessor — AssessorCo (on behalf of BrightBank)
lisa.cho@assessorco.com

--- Note: request accepted; will review the manifest when recieved.
